meta.project: AfriFarm Intelligent - cost lines for vegetable ROI engine (pilot zone Foumbot, Noun, West Cameroon)
meta.currency: XAF (CFA franc BEAC). 1 EUR = 655.957 XAF (fixed peg). XOF (CFA franc BCEAO) has the same parity, so Cote d'Ivoire listing prices in FCFA are numerically comparable but are NOT Cameroon prices.
meta.conventions: price_xaf = [min, max] in XAF for the stated unit. For MINADER bulletin items the range is the range of LOCAL MARKET AVERAGES across West-region towns; absolute min/max observations are in notes. 'derived' in notes means arithmetic by the compiler (per-kg x 50, currency conversion, man-days x wage), not a figure printed by the source. Non-price technical values use 'value' + 'value_unit' with price_xaf null.
meta.search_limit_note: The shared web-search budget for this turn ran out mid-research; remaining gaps were not searched exhaustively and can be revisited in a follow-up.
meta.round2: 2026-10-18 follow-up: added seed listing prices with pack sizes (CI, Nigeria, Senegal), Douala classified prices (pumps, tank, PE pipe, boots, poultry manure), Benin drip kit prices, CI crate and PPE listings, Niger extension field data on pump fuel. Prices taken from listing titles in search results are marked as such.

items.label: Generic chemical fertilizer / urea 50 kg bag: 2021 vs 2022 spike, and 30% subsidy
items.notes: Before spike: 18,000 (May 2021, national), 19,524 (pre-crisis reference cited by MINADER), urea 17,000 (North). Peak 2022: 35,000 (May 2022, national), 40,000 (Jul 2022, minister to parliament), urea >40,000 (North), Yaounde shops 30,000-45,000. Government/AfDB 3-year emergency plan: State pays 30% (12,000 of 40,000), target subsidised price 28,000/bag (C6, Jul 2022). WFP June 2022: NPK 20-10-10 up 9%-125% Jan-Jun 2022 across 24 markets, urea up 7%-180%; Douala port 240,000-280,000/t (Jan 2022) to 700,000-750,000/t (Jun 2022). FEWS NET May 2022: urea +80%, NPK 20-10-10 +70%, NPK 13-23-13 +80% in 3 months.

items.label: Fertilizer subsidy rate under PARPAC (2023-2024 campaigns)
items.notes: 2024 campaign: 80,000 t of fertilizer to be bought with 30% State support (launched 5 Apr 2024, Pouma). MINADER (Apr 2024): importers sell at wholesale price with a 30% reduction of the negotiated price. Farmers quoted in Jul 2023 said prices 'remain high' despite the subsidy. No subsidised per-bag price published for 2024-2026; access depends on producer-organisation registration.

items.label: Average fertilizer import unit value (all products, CIF-type value)
items.unit: XAF per 50 kg equivalent (derived from total value / tonnes)
items.notes: Derived: 2021 36.5 bn / 203,324 t = ~180 XAF/kg (8,976 per 50 kg); 2022 66.4 bn / 129,600 t = ~512 XAF/kg (25,617 per 50 kg); 2023 70.9 bn / 228,326 t = ~311 XAF/kg (15,526 per 50 kg). H1 2025 import value 44.4 bn vs 40.2 bn in H1 2024 (tonnage not given). One source (C12) states 73,724 t for 2021, inconsistent with MINADER's 201,705 t; MINADER figure preferred. Indicates prices eased in 2023 from the 2022 peak. Use as trend indicator only; retail = import value + margins + transport. Franc-zone cross-check (Niger, Jul 2024, not CEMAC): urea avg 19,000 per 50 kg bag (16,500-22,000), NPK 20-10-10 avg 18,690 (C55).

items.label: Hybrid tomato seed Cobra 26 F1 (Technisem), retail pack
items.unit: XAF per 50 g pack (CI) / per 5 g pack (Nigeria)
items.where: Cote d'Ivoire listing 65,000 per 50 g (C61); Nigeria listings NGN 21,500 per 5 g (C58) and NGN 19,500-21,000 pack size not stated (C51)
items.notes: LISTING PRICES, not Cameroon. Per gram (derived): CI 65,000/50 g = 1,300 XAF/g; Nigeria NGN 21,500 x 0.4375 = 9,406 XAF per 5 g = 1,881 XAF/g (converted at 1,332.47 NGN/USD (C46) and 582.92 XAF/USD (C38), i.e. 1 NGN = 0.4375 XAF). Planning value ~1,300-1,900 XAF/g. At PARPAC's 300 g/ha this would be ~390,000-565,000 XAF/ha (derived), vs 60,000 in the PARPAC budget (C3), so the PARPAC seed line is likely OP seed. Uncited Cameroon blog (C67): 150-250 g hybrid seed per ha for 80,000-250,000 XAF (320-1,667 XAF/g derived).

items.label: Task-based labour norms per hectare of tomato (man-days x 2,500)
items.notes: Man-days/ha: clearing 20 (50,000); ploughing (manual) 60 (150,000); ridging 30 (75,000); transplanting 30 (75,000); staking 10+20 (75,000); watering 25 (62,500); re-sowing 5 (12,500); fertilizer spreading 6 (15,000); fungicide/insecticide treatment 6 (15,000); herbicide 6 (15,000); weeding/earthing up 15 (37,500); pruning 15 (37,500); harvest 40 (100,000); packaging 2 (5,000). Nursery soil prep 500 XAF/m2 and disinfection 1,000 XAF/m2 (80 m2). Total labour ~834,500 XAF/ha (derived). Older East-region norm: harvest 500 XAF per 85 kg crate (C17, 2016).

items.label: 3-inch petrol motor pump, GX160-type engine, 60 m3/h (listing)
items.unit: XAF-equivalent per unit (XOF listing, par value)

items.notes: LISTING PRICES, not Cameroon; indicative for Chinese/generic units. Genuine Honda WB20XT retails ~414 EUR (271,600 XAF derived) in Europe (C25); Koshin SERH-50B 795.75 EUR incl. VAT (C29). Cameroon listings (Douala, Afribobo) are lower: see motor_pump_listing_douala.

items.label: 2-inch petrol pump fuel consumption (manufacturer/retailer specs)
items.notes: Honda WB20XT (GX120, 2.6 kW): 1.40 L/h (C25) or 1.1 L/h (C26), 2 L tank, ~1.4-2 h run time. Honda WB20XH (GX160, 4 kW / 5.5 PS max): 1.5 L/h, 3.1 L tank, 2.1 h (C27). Koshin SEH-50X (GX120, 4 hp): 1.0 L/h, 1.9 h (C28).

items.label: 2-inch petrol pump maximum flow rate
items.unit: m3 per hour (max, at zero head)
items.notes: Honda WB20XT 37.2 m3/h (620 L/min), head 32 m; Honda WB20 36 m3/h; Honda WB20XH 36 m3/h (600 L/min); Koshin SEH-50X 36 m3/h, head 30 m; Koshin SERH-50B (GX160, 5.5 HP, high-head 57 m) 26.4 m3/h. 3-inch Honda WB30 (GX160): 66 m3/h.

items.label: Fuel per m3 pumped, 2-inch petrol pump (derived)
items.value_unit: L/m3 at rated max flow; field value likely 2-3x higher
items.notes: Derived: 1.0 L/h / 36 m3/h = 0.028 L/m3; 1.5 L/h / 36 m3/h = 0.042 L/m3. price_xaf = derived fuel cost per m3 at 840 XAF/L super. Max flow is at zero head; with lift, friction in hoses and drip/sprinkler pressure, delivered flow is often far lower, so the compiler suggests a planning value of ~0.06-0.12 L/m3 (assumption, not sourced). Benin reference: ~768 L petrol per ha per year for motor-pump irrigation (derived from 768,000 L per 1,000 ha) and ~560,000 XOF/ha/yr fuel+lubricant saving when switching to solar (C31). PARPAC budget: fuel and lubricant 30,000 XAF per ha-cycle (~36 L super, derived) (C3), which looks low for dry-season tomato. Field references added: see pump_fuel_field_per_irrigation and pump_fuel_cost_field_sahel.

items.label: Drip irrigation kit (installed), per 1,000 m2
items.unit: XAF-equivalent per 1,000 m2 (derived from XOF kit prices)
items.notes: Derived: 1 ha kit 2,375,360 / 10 = 237,536 per 1,000 m2; 500 m2 kit 205,975 x 2 = 411,950 per 1,000 m2 (small kits cost more per m2). items.label: Super (petrol) pump price
items.notes: 840 since 3 Feb 2024 (+110 vs ~730 before; derived 730 from Feb 2023 to Feb 2024). Still 840 in Mar 2026 (C33) and Oct 2026 (C35); INS (Jul 2026) confirms no pass-through to administered pump prices. Import cost rising (super ~703 XAF/L, Oct 2026), so a future hike is a risk.

items.label: Gasoil (diesel) pump price
items.notes: 828 since 3 Feb 2024 (+108 vs ~720 before, derived). Oct 2026 import cost ~975 XAF/L, above pump price; State compensation. Kerosene (petrole lampant) 350 XAF/L (C32).

gaps: Still not found (null): bamboo/wooden stake prices; 3/4 or 1 inch 50-100 m garden hose; wooden cageot and 50 kg PP sack prices; standalone gloves and coveralls; zucchini seed price; any Cameroon shop price for vegetable seeds (all seed prices are from Cote d'Ivoire, Nigeria or Senegal listings); drip system lifespan (only a 3-year warranty); a Cameroon or humid-zone measurement of pump fuel per ha per season. From round 1, still open: 2024-2026 West-region fertilizer survey prices, NPK 12-24-12/KCl, foliar brands, active-ingredient pesticide prices, tractor hire, Foumbot land rent and wages, transport per trip/tonne, market fees, MFI rates. Quickest fix: phone/WhatsApp price checks with Foumbot and Bafoussam agro-dealers and transporters.
confidence_notes: HIGH: fuel prices (super 840, gasoil 828 XAF/L since 3 Feb 2024, confirmed through Oct 2026, with a real risk of a hike given import costs above pump prices); FX (BCEAO and Trading Economics, Oct 2026); MINADER Q4 2022 West-region input survey (official, includes Foumbot, but 2022 post-spike prices; import unit values fell ~40% from 2022 to 2023, so 2024-2026 retail is probably lower than Q4 2022 but this is not measured). MEDIUM: MINADER/PARPAC Oct 2024 tomato budget (official national template, not a market survey; some lines look inconsistent, e.g. calcium nitrate 13,500/bag, Decis 16,000 per '5 L', fuel 30,000 per ha-cycle; totals do not reconcile); pump technical specs (manufacturer data at max flow, real field output lower, so derived L/m3 understates fuel use). LOW: Jumia Cote d'Ivoire and Jiji Nigeria listing prices (other countries, listing not transaction, brand authenticity uncertain); 2008-2016 figures (manure, labour 1,500/day East region, maize-trial organic amendment); anecdotal press quotes (weeding labour 15,000 -> 50,000; trader transport). General: CPI vegetables +10.1% y/y and food +7.0% (Jul 2026), so older figures should be inflated before use. XOF prices are numerically comparable to XAF at the same EUR peg but reflect another market. ROUND 2: Seed prices are LISTINGS from Cote d'Ivoire (TM Business), Nigeria (Jiji, converted from NGN) and Senegal (SPIA); medium-low confidence for Cameroon use, but per-gram values are consistent (hybrid tomato ~875-1,900 XAF/g; OP tomato ~200-220 XAF/g; hybrid cucumber ~860 XAF/g). Douala classified prices (Afribobo) are real Cameroon listings but some posting dates are 2020-2022 or not visible, and several prices come only from listing titles. Drip kit prices are a Benin installer's 2020 list. Pump field fuel data come from Sahel extension sheets (deep wells, sandy soils), so treat them as upper bounds for Foumbot.
